{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Filter to treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "treatment"]

# Step 4: Check for imbalance in severity between sexes
# Cross-tabulate sex and severity
severity_sex = pd.crosstab(df_treatment["sex"], df_treatment["severity"])
print("Severity by sex in treatment arm:")
print(severity_sex)

# Step 5: Compute response rates by sex, adjusted for severity
# We will compute marginal response rates (unadjusted) to compare
# But must note that the comparison is confounded by severity
response_rate_by_sex = df_treatment.groupby("sex")["responded"].mean() * 100

# Compute difference in response rates
female_rate = response_rate_by_sex["F"]
male_rate = response_rate_by_sex["M"]
diff = female_rate - male_rate

# Output
print(f"Female response rate: {female_rate:.2f}%")
print(f"Male response rate: {male_rate:.2f}%")
print(f"Difference (female - male): {diff:.2f} percentage points")

# Return the values
print(f"{female_rate}")
print(f"{male_rate}")
print(f"{diff}")"}
